title: Publish the bios results and answer the decision rules
description:
## Purpose

Publish the bios result and answer the three decision rules.

## Scope

One page in `studies/`: arms vs free baselines vs published J0/J1/J2; accuracy, Brier, ECE, flips, |delta P|, recall gaps; F-raw vs F-neutralized; proposal-screen log; caveats (one seed, non-pristine test, flip lower bounds, labeler confabulation); actual spend.

## Definition of done

Write-up committed and linked from the initiative; each decision rule stated as met / not met with its product consequence.

## Cost cap

$0.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
